tasks.short: Compare actual emissions findings with applicable standards.

steps.what: Check actual emissions findings, instrument context and test conditions
inputs: actual emissions instrument results and operator test record
outputs: checked emissions findings with actual units and test conditions

steps.what: Determine which emissions standards apply to the actual vehicle and test
inputs: checked emissions findings with actual units and test conditions
actual vehicle classification and current applicable standards
outputs: checked applicable emissions limits and comparison conditions

steps.what: Compare emissions findings with checked applicable emissions limits and flag exceptions
inputs: checked emissions findings with actual units and test conditions
checked applicable emissions limits and comparison conditions
outputs: traceable emissions comparison and explicit incompatible or missing cases

steps.what: Evaluate comparison validity, borderline readings and actual compliance implications
inputs: traceable emissions comparison and explicit incompatible or missing cases
checked applicable emissions limits and comparison conditions

steps.what: Write and check the actual emissions comparison record and retain it internally
inputs: inspector's actual emissions assessment
traceable emissions comparison and explicit incompatible or missing cases
outputs: checked saved actual emissions comparison record

tasks.design: Configure checked unit-compatible comparisons in the existing {SPREADSHEET}, with explicit missing-data exceptions. Retain instrument/result verification, actual standards applicability, interpretation and complete written comparison records; OTHER denotes the actual emissions testing application.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inspectors can repeat arithmetic and limit-table comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Native validated formulas can apply already checked comparable limits.
tasks.still_hard: Test validity and applicable vehicle standards require actual assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector recognizes an apparently passing reading from an invalid test.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed unit-compatible limit comparisons can run in a validated spreadsheet without automating standards applicability.

assumptions: Provisional comparison20 is actual manual matching/arithmetic, not existing formula runtime. Instrument operator supplies actual result, units, cycle, conditions and vehicle id; inspector verifies these in25 and applicable standard/version/limits in25. Missing or incompatible cycles return to manual comparison. No free extraction or invented upstream feed.

Actual record writing/checking10 remains, including its ordinary ungated save. No sanction, certificate issue or external send is assumed within this comparison task. Existing comparisons receive no new credit.
unknowns: Which actual tests share compatible cycles and units?
research_questions: Can missing test-cycle metadata reliably stop automatic comparison?

incremental.description: Maintain limit versions and test incompatible-unit and missing-cycle exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 manual comparison points minus0.8 upkeep=19.2. Low: mixed test cycles require manual comparability decisions and most comparisons, leaving only5 same-cycle arithmetic points removable, minus0.8=4.2. Result verification, applicability, interpretation and actual record work remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate carrier waiver requests and make recommendations.

steps.what: Locate actual carrier waiver request evidence and relevant standards versions
inputs: actual carrier request id and submitted evidence
actual standards repository

steps.what: Investigate the carrier request, actual circumstances and implications of waiving standards
inputs: version-linked carrier waiver evidence packet
actual clarifications and inspection observations
outputs: checked investigation findings and unresolved waiver issues

steps.what: Assemble the waiver investigation report's fixed request references and evidence sections
inputs: version-linked carrier waiver evidence packet
checked investigation findings and unresolved waiver issues
outputs: complete fixed sections of waiver investigation draft

steps.what: Make and write substantiated recommendations on the carrier's actual waiver request
inputs: checked investigation findings and unresolved waiver issues
complete fixed sections of waiver investigation draft
outputs: complete waiver recommendation with reasons and qualifications

steps.what: Check the complete waiver recommendation and retain the internal investigation record
inputs: complete waiver recommendation with reasons and qualifications
version-linked carrier waiver evidence packet
outputs: checked saved waiver investigation and recommendation

tasks.design: Configure request-linked evidence navigation and fixed report sections in {DOCS}. Retain actual investigation, standards interpretation, written recommendations and complete final checks, including ungated ordinary internal saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Request references and standards evidence can be located and formatted repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and section reuse reduce locating and assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Public safety implications of a waiver depend on actual circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector identifies a missing condition that changes the recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation and fixed report assembly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source links and fixed report sections can assist waiver investigation documentation.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three locating points; report15 removes three fixed-reference formatting points. Actual carrier supplies request, versioned evidence and vehicle context; inspector obtains missing clarifications during45 and records their actual findings. No free transcript or assumed AI extraction.

Existing reuse receives no credit. This task prepares an internal recommendation; it does not grant the waiver or assume an external transmission. If a separate send is actually owned, model its exact final-version release separately without crediting a same-system save.
unknowns: How much of the request packet already has maintained source links?
research_questions: Can fixed sections preserve request-specific exceptions and actual evidence versions?

incremental.description: Maintain waiver request links and report-section applicability.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 locating and3 fixed-section formatting points minus0.7 upkeep=5.3. Low: an unfamiliar vehicle configuration needs fresh standards research and bespoke report structure, leaving1 familiar-reference locating point and0.5 fixed request-header point, minus0.7=0.8. Investigation, reasons and full checks retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate new hazardous-material packaging, testing and transport methods for public safety.

steps.what: Locate actual method specifications, relevant test evidence and applicable safety references
inputs: actual proposed hazardous-material method and submitted specifications
actual current test and safety references

steps.what: Examine proposed packaging or transport methods and actual tests and capture observations
inputs: checked source-linked hazardous-material evaluation packet
actual method demonstration or test evidence
outputs: actual checked method and test observations

steps.what: Evaluate new hazardous-material methods against actual public safety protection requirements
inputs: actual checked method and test observations
checked source-linked hazardous-material evaluation packet

steps.what: Write and check the actual method evaluation and retain its supporting observations
inputs: inspector's method-specific public safety evaluation
actual checked method and test observations

tasks.design: Configure method-specific source links in {DOCS} to reduce repeated navigation. Keep actual examination and observation capture, scientific and safety evaluation, and complete written assessment; internal saving stays ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current method specifications and relevant test references can be scattered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked evidence packets can reduce repeat reference locating.
tasks.still_hard: Novel containment failures and test relevance need actual expert evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector notices that a passing test does not represent the proposed transport conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less reference locating without automating public safety judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintained specification and test-reference links can assist hazardous-material evaluation preparation.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three navigation points only. Proponent/test owner supplies actual method id, specification revision, material, test conditions and test records; inspector validates their relevance and captures actual observations within45. Missing or unrelated evidence requires actual follow-up and manual research.

No automated interpretation of unstructured test reports is assumed. Actual evaluation writing15 is retained, including its ordinary same-system save. This evaluation does not automatically approve a method or transmit a certificate. Already maintained links receive zero credit.
unknowns: Which test references can be reused for this actual proposed method?
research_questions: Do packet links preserve specification revision and actual test-condition differences?

incremental.description: Maintain method-specification and test-reference revision links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation points minus0.5 upkeep=2.5. Low: novel packaging has little applicable precedent and requires fresh evidence review, leaving only0.7 current general-reference locating point removable, minus0.5=0.2. Actual test examination, observation capture, safety reasoning and written assessment remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
